    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "\n",
        "file_path = '/content/drive/MyDrive/Customer Purchase Behavior Analysis.xlsx'\n",
        "\n",
        "orders = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Orders')\n",
        "customers = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Customers')\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Both datasets loaded successfully!\")\n",
        "print(\"Orders shape:\", orders.shape)\n",
        "print(\"Customers shape:\", customers.shape)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "MefRxHAqICCM",
        "outputId": "aaad5670-4a60-475e-92b4-1f938430d15f"

            "Both datasets loaded successfully!\n",

            "Customers shape: (180, 12)\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "model_data = orders_clean[\n",
        "    ['customer_id', 'sales_channel', 'order_total_ksh']\n",
        "].dropna().copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Model dataset shape:\", model_data.shape)\n",
        "print(\"\\nMissing values:\")\n",
        "print(model_data.isnull().sum())\n",
        "print(\"\\nSample records:\")\n",
        "print(model_data.head())"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "I0HeN9VwKinB",
        "outputId": "77dae0c3-6dd9-41dc-d611-0d2e3a5a9d97"

      "execution_count": null,

        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Model dataset shape: (650, 3)\n",
            "\n",
            "Missing values:\n",
            "customer_id        0\n",
            "sales_channel      0\n",
            "order_total_ksh    0\n",
            "dtype: int64\n",
            "\n",
            "Sample records:\n",
            "  customer_id    sales_channel  order_total_ksh\n",
            "0    CUST0116          Website          12430.0\n",
            "1    CUST0146          Website           2574.0\n",
            "2    CUST0022       Mobile App          16600.0\n",
            "3    CUST0066       Mobile App           4703.0\n",
            "4    CUST0007  Social Commerce           9491.0\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "mixed_model = smf.mixedlm(\n",
        "    \"order_total_ksh ~ C(sales_channel)\",\n",
        "    data=model_data,\n",
        "    groups=model_data[\"customer_id\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "mixed_result = mixed_model.fit(\n",
        "    reml=False,\n",
        "    method=\"lbfgs\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(mixed_result.summary())"
      ],
      "metadata": {

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "customer_summary = model_data.groupby('customer_id').agg(\n",
        "    order_count=('order_total_ksh', 'count'),\n",
        "    average_order_value=('order_total_ksh', 'mean'),\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "icc = (\n",
        "    powell_result.cov_re.iloc[0, 0] /\n",
        "    (powell_result.cov_re.iloc[0, 0] + powell_result.scale)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "random_effect_values = pd.Series({\n",
        "    customer: effect.iloc[0]\n",
        "    for customer, effect in powell_result.random_effects.items()\n",
        "})\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"INTRACLASS CORRELATION (ICC):\")\n",
        "print(icc)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nRANDOM EFFECT SUMMARY:\")\n",
        "print(random_effect_values.describe())\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nCUSTOMERS WITH HIGHEST POSITIVE RANDOM EFFECTS:\")\n",
        "print(random_effect_values.nlargest(5))\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nCUSTOMERS WITH LOWEST RANDOM EFFECTS:\")\n",
        "print(random_effect_values.nsmallest(5))"

        "from scipy.stats import chi2\n",
        "\n",
        "lr_stat = 2 * (\n",
        "    full_ml_result.llf - null_ml_result.llf\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "p_value = chi2.sf(lr_stat, df=2)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"LIKELIHOOD RATIO TEST\")\n",
        "print(\"LR statistic:\", lr_stat)\n",
        "print(\"Degrees of freedom:\", 2)\n",
        "print(\"P-value:\", p_value)"
      ],

          ]
